title: Machine step setting says it works for pound users but does nothing
what: A member who uses pounds can pick '5 kg' under Machine and cable steps. The row and its line still say the gym's machines go up 5 kg at a time, but the app ignores the choice in pounds, so the next weight is the same as before. A test even confirms the choice is ignored, and nothing checks what the screen tells the member.
expected: In pounds, either the steps work in pounds, or the setting says plainly that it is only for kilograms.
how_often: every time a pound user changes the setting
fix_line: Show a 'for kilograms only' line in pounds, or hide the setting, and test the words
